title: Exploring the Role of Globular Domain Locations on an Intrinsically Disordered Region of p53: A Molecular Dynamics Investigation.
authors: Bakker, Michael J; Sorensen, Henrik V; Skepo, Marie
journal: Journal of chemical theory and computation
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究p53无序区PTL的构象动态，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关蛋白p53，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合或互作机制，方法为MD但对象与互作轴均偏离核心课题。
abstract: The pre-tetramerization loop (PTL) of the human tumor suppressor protein p53 is an intrinsically disordered region (IDR) necessary for the tetramerization process, and its flexibility contributes to the essential conformational changes needed. Although the IDR can be accurately simulated in the traditional manner of molecular dynamics (MD) with the end-to-end distance (EE(dist)) unhindered, we sought to explore the effects of restraining the EE(dist) to the values predicted by electron microscopy (EM) and other distances. Simulating the PTL trajectory with a restrained EE(dist) , we found an increased agreement of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) chemical shifts with experiments. Additionally, we observed a plethora of secondary structures and contacts that only appear when the trajectory is restrained. Our findings expand the understanding of the tetramerization of p53 and provide insight into how mutations could make the protein impotent. In particular, our findings demonstrate the importance of restraining the EE(dist) in studying IDRs and how their conformations change under different conditions. Our results provide a better understanding of the PTL and the conformational dynamics of IDRs in general, which are useful for further studies regarding mutations and their effects on the activity of p53.
abstract_zh: 人肿瘤抑制蛋白p53的前四聚化环（PTL）是一个内在无序区域（IDR），对四聚化过程至关重要，其灵活性促成了必要的构象变化。尽管IDR可以通过传统的分子动力学（MD）方法在端到端距离（EE(dist)）不受限制的情况下精确模拟，我们试图探索将EE(dist)限制在电子显微镜（EM）预测值及其他距离值时的效应。通过以受限的EE(dist)模拟PTL轨迹，我们发现核磁共振（NMR）化学位移与实验结果的吻合度提高。此外，我们观察到仅在轨迹受限时出现的多种二级结构和接触。我们的发现扩展了对p53四聚化的理解，并提供了突变如何使蛋白质失活的见解。特别地，我们的研究证明了在IDR研究中限制EE(dist)的重要性，以及其构象在不同条件下的变化方式。我们的结果增进了对PTL及IDR整体构象动力学的理解，这对于进一步研究突变及其对p53活性的影响具有参考价值。
